_doc: Intentional differences from the live site. A URL listed here passes only if the target returns exactly this result and location (path compared decoded, without trailing slash).

/search-result/.reason: Live renders an empty WordPress search page; we consolidate onto the AI search page.

/partner-portal/.reason: Live 302s signed-out visitors to wp-login.php; ours goes to our own login with a return path.

/partner-portal-2/.reason: Duplicate of /partner-portal/ on live; consolidated with a redirect.
